According to his obituary, A.W. was a descendant of Sir William Phipps, a celebrated Englishman.

His father was Paton Randolph Phipps and a soldier of the War of 1812. His grandfather served in the revolutionary war.
He grew up in a family of eight children.

A.W. Phipps was a celebrated pioneer of photography and had a gallery for 50 years. His brother William came to study under him.

His first wife was Sarah Wood, daughter of Dr. John Wood and a granddaughter of Rev. Wick. A.W. and Sarah had two children - Clara survived.

A.W. later married Lizzie Devlin and they had a daughter, Harriet who became the wife of Rev. J.Q.A McDowell. 

2nd namesake for Albigence Waldo, surgeon with the Continental Army, a founder of the Medical Society of Windham County, Connecticut. 1st namesake born in 1823 & died age 1.5 years old.
